meta.title: Stablecoin key events, 2017 to Oct 2026
meta.purpose: Annotation layer for the Grain Bin 'shape of things' chart (events mapped against total stablecoin supply over time).

schema.date: ISO date; for datePrecision=month use the first of the month
schema.category: launch | regulation | enforcement | depeg | collapse | institutional | security | market | scheduled
schema.importance: 1 = always label, 2 = label when zoomed in, 3 = tooltip only
schema.title: short label (<= 40 chars) for on-chart marker
schema.summary: one or two sentences for tooltip
schema.confidence: high = well documented | medium = date or detail approximate | low = single source, verify

notes: Do not hardcode supply numbers from this file for the chart; use Grain Bin's own data series. The marketCapAnchors block is only for sanity checks.
Aggregators disagree by several $B (DefiLlama vs CoinMarketCap vs CoinGecko). Peak figures in 2026 range from about $322B to $323B depending on source.
Pre-2020 supply anchors intentionally omitted; compute from your own data.

marketCapAnchors.source: record peak, May to June 2026; sources range 322 to 323

events.title: Tether treasury hack
events.summary: About $31M of USDT was stolen from Tether's treasury wallet; Tether froze the funds and moved to a patched Omni Layer implementation.

events.title: MakerDAO launches Sai
events.summary: First major decentralized, crypto-collateralized stablecoin goes live on Ethereum (single-collateral DAI, later renamed Sai).

events.title: TrueUSD launches
events.summary: TUSD debuts as one of the first fiat-backed stablecoins marketed on third-party attestations.

events.title: NYDFS approves PAX and GUSD
events.summary: New York regulators approve Paxos Standard and Gemini Dollar, the first regulated, fully reserved US dollar stablecoins.

events.title: USDC launches
events.summary: Circle and Coinbase (via the Centre consortium) launch USD Coin, which becomes the main regulated-leaning rival to USDT.

events.title: NY AG sues Bitfinex and Tether
events.summary: New York's attorney general alleges Bitfinex covered up about $850M in losses using Tether reserves; this starts the long reserve-transparency fight.

events.title: Facebook announces Libra
events.summary: Facebook's Libra whitepaper puts stablecoins on the radar of global regulators and central banks. It was renamed Diem in Dec 2020 and wound down in Jan 2022.

events.title: Binance USD launches
events.summary: Paxos-issued BUSD, branded by Binance and approved by NYDFS, launches. It grows to be a top-3 stablecoin before being wound down in 2023.

events.title: Multi-Collateral Dai
events.summary: MakerDAO upgrades to multi-collateral DAI, letting assets beyond ETH back the stablecoin.

events.title: Black Thursday
events.summary: A sharp ETH crash and network congestion cause Maker vault liquidation failures and DAI to trade off peg. Maker later adds USDC as collateral, deepening DAI's link to centralized stablecoins.

events.title: DeFi summer begins
events.summary: Compound's COMP distribution kicks off yield farming; stablecoin demand as DeFi collateral and trading pairs drives the first big supply surge (about $5B to about $27B across 2020).

events.title: OCC says banks can back stablecoins
events.summary: OCC interpretive letter confirms national banks may hold reserves backing stablecoins, the first sign of US bank-regulator openness.

events.title: Tether settles with NY AG
events.summary: Tether and Bitfinex pay $18.5M and agree to publish periodic reserve breakdowns and stop trading with New York.

events.title: Anchor Protocol launches on Terra
events.summary: A roughly 20% 'savings' yield on UST drives rapid growth of Terra's algorithmic stablecoin through 2021 and early 2022.

events.title: Tether reserve breakdown published
events.summary: First detailed reserve composition shows only a small share held as cash and a large share as commercial paper, fueling reserve-quality concerns.

events.title: CFTC fines Tether $41M
events.summary: CFTC orders Tether to pay $41M for misstatements about its reserves, and Bitfinex to pay $1.5M.

events.title: President's Working Group report
events.summary: US Treasury-led report urges Congress to restrict stablecoin issuance to insured depository institutions, setting the policy debate that led to GENIUS.

events.title: Diem winds down
events.summary: Diem Association sells its assets to Silvergate and shuts down, ending Meta's stablecoin effort.

events.title: Terra UST collapse
events.summary: UST loses its peg and LUNA hyperinflates over about a week; USDT briefly dips toward $0.95 on May 12. Total supply peaked just before and begins a roughly 18-month contraction.

events.title: OFAC sanctions Tornado Cash
events.summary: First sanctions on a smart-contract protocol; Circle freezes USDC in sanctioned addresses, showing centralized issuers can and will blacklist.

events.title: Tether exits commercial paper
events.summary: Tether says it has reduced commercial paper to zero and shifted reserves toward US Treasuries.

events.title: FTX bankruptcy
events.summary: FTX files for bankruptcy; exchange-driven demand for stablecoins falls and supply keeps shrinking through 2023.

events.title: BUSD minting halted
events.summary: NYDFS orders Paxos to stop minting BUSD and the SEC signals action; BUSD supply runs off over the next year, with much of it migrating to USDT and later TUSD/FDUSD.

events.title: SVB failure, USDC depegs
events.summary: Circle discloses $3.3B stuck at Silicon Valley Bank; USDC falls to about $0.87 on Mar 11 and DAI follows. It repegs on Mar 13 after US authorities backstop SVB depositors.

events.title: EU MiCA enters into force
events.summary: The EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation becomes law, with stablecoin rules phased in from mid-2024.

events.title: Aave launches GHO
events.summary: Aave's native overcollateralized stablecoin goes live on Ethereum mainnet.

events.title: PayPal launches PYUSD
events.summary: First stablecoin from a major US payments company, issued by Paxos.

events.title: Ethena USDe launches
events.summary: Synthetic dollar backed by delta-hedged crypto collateral offers high yield and grows quickly, becoming a top-3 stablecoin in 2025.

events.title: MiCA stablecoin rules apply
events.summary: EU rules for asset-referenced and e-money tokens take effect; full MiCA applies Dec 30, 2024. Exchanges later restrict non-compliant stablecoins such as USDT for EEA users.

events.title: Stripe to acquire Bridge
events.summary: Stripe announces a roughly $1.1B acquisition of stablecoin infrastructure firm Bridge, signaling big payments companies treating stablecoins as rails.

events.title: Ripple launches RLUSD
events.summary: Ripple's NYDFS-regulated dollar stablecoin goes live.

events.title: Executive order backs USD stablecoins
events.summary: Trump signs a digital-assets executive order supporting dollar-backed stablecoins and barring a US CBDC.

events.title: World Liberty USD1
events.summary: Trump-family-linked World Liberty Financial launches USD1; it gains scale after being used for a $2B MGX investment in Binance (May 2025) and reaches top-5 by cap.

events.title: Circle IPO
events.summary: Circle lists on the NYSE (CRCL), the first major public listing of a stablecoin issuer.

events.title: Senate passes GENIUS Act
events.summary: Bipartisan Senate passage of the first US federal payment-stablecoin framework; the House followed on Jul 17.

events.title: GENIUS Act signed into law
events.summary: First US federal stablecoin law: 1:1 reserves, monthly disclosures, redemption rights, issuer licensing. Effective on the earlier of Jan 18, 2027 or 120 days after final rules.

events.title: Hong Kong stablecoin regime live
events.summary: Hong Kong's Stablecoins Ordinance takes effect, creating an issuer licensing regime.

events.title: Treasury GENIUS ANPRM
events.summary: Treasury opens implementation of the GENIUS Act with an advance notice seeking comment on safe harbors and comparability of foreign regimes.

events.title: 10/10 crash, USDe depegs on Binance
events.summary: About $19B of leveraged positions are liquidated in a day. USDe briefly traded near $0.65 on Binance while holding near $1 elsewhere; Ethena handled about $2B in redemptions. Growth stalled afterward.

events.title: Western Union plans stablecoin
events.summary: Western Union announces a dollar stablecoin on Solana issued by Anchorage Digital.

events.title: Stream Finance xUSD collapse
events.summary: Yield-bearing xUSD loses its peg after Stream Finance discloses a large fund-manager loss; related synthetic dollars such as deUSD also unwind.

events.title: Tether launches USAT
events.summary: Tether launches a GENIUS-oriented US stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, its return to the US market.

events.title: OCC proposes GENIUS rule
events.summary: OCC issues its 376-page implementing proposal (Federal Register Mar 2) with a $5M capital floor for issuers. FDIC (Apr 7) and NCUA (May) followed with their own proposals.

events.title: FinCEN/OFAC and state-regime proposals
events.summary: FinCEN and OFAC propose AML and sanctions rules for issuers; Treasury proposes principles for acceptable state stablecoin regimes.

events.title: Supply record, about $322B
events.summary: Total stablecoin supply hits an all-time high around May to June 2026 (sources range $322B to $323B), then slips about $10B over the following weeks.

events.title: MiCA transition period ends
events.summary: EU MiCA transitional arrangements expire, tightening enforcement on non-authorized crypto-asset service providers and stablecoins.

events.title: GENIUS rulemaking deadline missed
events.summary: The one-year statutory deadline passes without final rules from Treasury or the four primary regulators; the Jan 18, 2027 backstop effective date becomes the controlling date.

events.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS rule
events.summary: OCC issues its final implementing rule: $5M capital floor, more flexible reserve management, and waivers of up to 12 months for existing issuers. Other agencies' final rules still pending.

events.title: GENIUS Act takes effect (scheduled)
events.summary: Statutory effective date. Draw as a future marker, not a data point.
